book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.ar: الرانغون باخرة كبيرة، ورحلتها تلاتعشر يوم.
sentences.en: The Rangoon was a big steamer, and her passage thirteen days.

sentences.ar: وعودا صارت تقعد مع فوغ عالسطح.
sentences.en: And Aouda began sitting with Fogg on deck.
She talked, and he listened.
And she asked, and he answered.
In short, polite, cold sentences.
And Aouda did not understand him.

sentences.ar: بس كانت تحس إنه، تحت البرود، في شي دافي.
sentences.en: But she felt that, under the coldness, there was something warm.
And Passepartout watched them, and was glad.

sentences.ar: وبيوم، شاف على السطح وجه بيعرفه.
sentences.en: And one day, he saw on deck a face he knew.
Fix!
Passepartout said: you here?
Fix said: me?
A coincidence!
Going to Hong Kong, on business.
Passepartout said: amazing!
The same road!
And was glad, because his friend was back.
But at night, Passepartout thought.
Fix at Suez.
Fix in Bombay.
Fix on the Rangoon.
And every time asking about my master.
And he understood, or thought he did.
He said: this man is a spy!
From the Reform Club!

sentences.ar: بعتوه يتأكد إنه سيدي بيلف حول الدنيا فعلاً!
sentences.en: They sent him to make sure my master really goes round the world!
And laughed.
And decided not to tell Fogg.
So he would not be hurt by his friends.

sentences.ar: وفيكس، من جهته، ما كان فاهم شي.
sentences.en: And Fix, for his part, understood nothing.
A thief steals fifty-five thousand.
And flees round the world.

sentences.ar: وبنص الطريق، بيوقف يخاطر بحياته عشان مرا ما بيعرفها؟
sentences.en: And halfway, stops to risk his life for a woman he does not know?

sentences.ar: وبيدفع ألفين جنيه كفالة عشان خادم؟
sentences.en: And pays two thousand bail for a servant?

sentences.ar: قال فيكس: يا إما هو أذكى رجل بالدنيا.
sentences.en: Fix said: either he is the cleverest man in the world.
Or I am the stupidest.
And decided: in Hong Kong, I take him.
With the warrant or without.
